nodes.name: 不点的灯
nodes.light: cold blue dusk in the fog, warm pinpoint lamp-lights from the altar island far ahead, the unlit lantern a dark shape
nodes.camera: from behind and a little below the guide, looking down the bridge into the fog, the lock girl in the near left; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a foggy winter evening at the east bridge of a river city. A long stone bridge of pale planks crosses a dark river into thick white fog, and the mist is so heavy that the far end is invisible. In the middle of the picture, walking away from us toward the bridge-end and seen from behind at three-quarter, goes a small dog-eared beastkin boy of fourteen, about 150 cm, thin, with a shock of sandy-gold hair and two large drooping dog ears set on top of his head, in grey wool with rope-brown straps; in his hand he carries a lantern that is not lit. Where he steps, the fog opens a person's width ahead of his shoes and closes again behind, and the planks come clear one by one. Behind him in a long line on the bridge come the envoys of seven kingdoms, each in a different house colour with a pennant: gold and white, black and iron, lake blue, red and sand, green, plain brown, dark violet, stepping carefully on the revealed planks. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a small girl of fourteen who looks about twelve crouches at a wall of iron locks on the gatehouse, with chopped ragged black hair and brass-coloured eyes, in a robe far too big for her with the sleeves rolled three times and a bunch of keys on her front; she has put her lips to a keyhole and is blowing a small breath into it, eyes narrowed, mischievous. Behind her a heavy rack of hundreds of swords hangs hilt-out on the gatehouse wall. Far beyond in the fog float many small lights of an island of altars. Drifting fog and a few snowflakes are large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕：犬耳向导提不点的灯带七国使节过桥，锁匠学徒给使节馆换锁、在锁芯里吹一口气（源稿第185行）。两个都是十四岁，穿戴整齐，没有受伤。

nodes.name: 坡口
nodes.light: furnace orange from the fire rings and the wolf king's mane against deep cold blue-black night, the boy's face lit orange from the left
nodes.camera: low at the boy's side behind the shield's rim, looking up at him and across to the wolf king looming at the left edge, cut off by the frame; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the night before a treaty, at the rim of a great crater-basin. Fog covers the ground and is lit orange from within by rings of fire. In the left half of the picture, huge and partly cut off by the frame, stands the ember-maned wolf king, a dire wolf taller than a warhorse with a dull-red mane whose fire is tucked inside and burns open as it moves, its dark-red eyes clear and fixed on the right; its jaws are open and it has just spoken two words in a human voice. Around it, fainter in the fog, more flame wolves lope, lighting the grass as they run, and rings of fire close in across the slope. In the middle right, at the lip of the slope, stands a sixteen-year-old squire alone in front of a camp: Anselm Mistbridge, about 186 cm, tall and long-limbed and still thin, hair the pale colour of lakeside reeds, thick honey-brown brows, honey-amber eyes, a face not yet filled out, in a mail shirt. He has just driven the foot of a huge round tower shield, painted with a ring of lake and one star, into the earth in front of him, his right hand on its rim and his left holding a white-ash spear, and he stands behind it with his legs braced; in a ring around him the wind has dropped and the grass and the smoke stand still. Behind him, small, a dozen men with spears have steadied on the slope among overturned carts, cooks and grooms and wounded men huddling behind them; scattered horses bolt away. Sparks and drifting ash are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 二幕：立盟前一夜，背盾的扈从带营里十几个人站到坡口，盾一顿，风停了（源稿第197行）。安瑟姆十六岁，画他一顿盾的那一下，盾还没裂、腿还没伤，没有画受伤。

nodes.name: 一里地
nodes.light: hard bright late-morning daylight, long shadows, the white glow of the feather at her collar the one soft point
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the dead tree, looking along the ground at her as she runs toward us, the arrows streaking in from the right; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late morning on the white-stone plateau outside a river city, in the open mile of ground between two armies. We stand on the grass at the foot of a single dead tree in the middle of that mile, looking back toward the army she came from. In the middle foreground the deer-eared courier is running, caught at the instant after she has turned at the tree: a tall slender woman of forty-three, about 168 cm, with two long slim white-tipped deer ears set on top of her head standing upright, the back of her left ear (on the viewer's right) notched, cream-coloured short hair blown backward, pale amber eyes set wide apart, in a grey cloak and deerskin; her cloak flies out behind her and a small sealed packet is clutched against her chest in her left hand. One long arrow has just struck her in the upper back: its shaft stands out between her shoulder blades and a dark red stain spreads across the grey cloak, and she runs on. Six more arrows are in the air behind and beside her, long dark lines, and one is just striking the grass. The feather at the collar of her cloak glows white. On both sides of the picture, far off and small, the two armies stand in their ranks, one in gold and white, one in black and iron, and their archers have their bows raised. Behind her across the ground the plain is silent; the dead tree stands at the left of the picture. Grass seeds, dust and a few feathers are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 三幕：她从日轮阵里跑到黑石阵里递信、取回信往回跑，七支箭一支接着一支（源稿第203行）。画第一支箭到的那一瞬，她还在跑。成年人，raw。

nodes.name: 鹿皮鞋
nodes.light: low warm gold of the setting sun from the right on the shoes, deep blue shade under the eaves, a little lamp-light from inside
nodes.camera: from the side at the height of the hanging shoes, looking along the row toward the pair being hung; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening, the eaves of a low timber hall of a couriers' guild on the white-stone plateau. Under the long eaves hangs a row of worn deerskin shoes on pegs, dozens of them, evenly spaced, each pair tied by its laces and swaying a little in the wind; the soles of the nearest are worn right through. In the middle foreground, seen from the side at three-quarter, two couriers in grey cloaks with a white feather at the collar, a man and a woman, both with long soft animal ears, stand on a low step hanging the last pair at the end of the row, the man holding the pair up by its laces and the woman setting the peg; their faces are quiet and tired. Beside them on a bench sits an old hare-eared man of about seventy with very long white ears lying back over his shoulders, a stick across his knees, his eyes closed, counting the pairs with a slight movement of one finger. Beyond the eaves the plateau runs away in gold grass, and in the very middle of the open ground, far off and small, a big bronze bell hangs on a frame between two posts with a rope running to each side. Warm lamp-light from the hall behind them falls on the shoes. Drifting dust, straw and a few small white feathers are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 收束：羽信会的人把她磨穿底的鹿皮鞋挂到屋檐下那一排的最后（源稿第213行），远处一口刀熔的钟（第218行）。没有立绘的人都写成一般的信使，坐着数鞋的老兔耳是源稿里管跑信的老人。

nodes.name: 夜课
nodes.light: the warm amber of the gatehouse lamp on the right, the cold blue night, and the silver of a thousand star reflections in the lake
nodes.camera: low, from the bridge planks at the guard's feet, looking along the bridge past the flute player to the mist; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: autumn night on a long white-wooden bridge in a lake-city whose streets are bridges and whose lanes are canals. The long bridge runs away from us to the right into a bank of thick white mist at the far end, the northern shore, with a small gatehouse and a hanging lamp at this end. On the bridge in the near left sits the court flute player, seen from three-quarter: a thin man of forty-four, tall, neatly trimmed blue-black hair with only a few thread-thin white hairs at the temples, lake-blue eyes looking sideways as if listening to someone, fine lines at the corners of the eyes, a polite remote face, in a dark blue court coat, a small bone vial at his belt. He is playing a long flute with his eyes half closed, the same tune he has played for a month. Below the bridge a dozen small boats have stopped their oars on the lake, the boatmen holding the oar handles with faces turned up; a small boy of about seven in the nearest boat, with a reed in his hand, is blowing it to the same tune. The water mirrors more stars than the sky holds, and the reflections shine. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands the bridge-guard Sabina under the gatehouse lamp: a tall strong young woman of twenty-two with reed-gold hair in a coiled braid, thick brows, green eyes, in a leather coat, a long spear upright in her right hand, a round tower shield on her back painted with a ring of lake and one star; she is looking at the flute player, counting. A string of old bells hangs under the gatehouse. Mist and drifting lamp-glow are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 一幕：乐师夜夜在长桥上吹同一支曲，船停桨，船家的孩子攥芦苇跟着吹，萨碧娜在岗上数他吹了多久（源稿第267到268行）。

nodes.name: 鸦落船头
nodes.light: the cold silver-blue of the last star reflections on the black water, a single warm point of lamplight far behind, the crow a darker silhouette
nodes.camera: low over the black water at the barge's stern, looking over the seated man's shoulder along the prow toward the mist; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dead of night on a lake. A small dark wooden barge of the palace, with a high carved prow, glides away over the black water by itself: no oars, no sail, no hand on the tiller. On its prow sits one black crow, wings half folded, facing forward, and ahead of it the water is dark and open. At the stern, in the near middle and seen from behind at three-quarter, sits the flute player, a thin man of forty-four in a dark blue coat, blue-black hair, a long flute held against his chest in both arms, not playing; he does not turn his head. Behind the barge on the water the reflected stars are going out one by one, a long dark trail of dead reflections leading back to the lit lake-city, which stands in the far left, small, its lights low in tiers on the water. At the end of a long bridge there, tiny, a young woman holds a lamp high above her head with both hands, a long spear leaning on her shoulder. Beyond the barge, on the far shore, a wall of pale mist waits. Two more small boats put out from the city and turn back in the haze. Tiny stars, drifting mist and a few black feathers are large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕：黑鸦落在王宫那条船的船头，船自己离岸，倒影的星一颗颗熄了，萨碧娜把桥灯举得比往夜都高（源稿第276到279行）。萨碧娜在远处当小人，who 里列着是给参考用的。

nodes.name: 北岸归人
nodes.light: the pale pink-gold of first light low in the mist, the lamp's warm amber, a cold white glow around the walking man
nodes.camera: low at the guard's shoulder, looking out along the bridge to the figure coming out of the mist; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early spring dawn, the long bridge at the edge of a lake-city. The bridge runs from the lower left of the picture toward a bank of white mist at the far end, and out of the mist a single figure walks toward us, alone, stopping after each step as if waiting for someone behind him to catch up. He is the flute player, seen from the front: a thin man of forty-four, tall, blue-black hair, lake-blue eyes, in a dark blue coat that is travel-worn, its shoulders dusted with fine ash-white sand; his face is calm, he is looking at the empty air beside him, and in one hand he carries a small bone vial. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands the bridge-guard Sabina seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek: a tall strong woman of twenty-two with a coil of reed-gold braid, thick brows, in leather, holding a lamp high in her left hand and her long spear grounded in her right, the lamp's light pushing through the mist to the far shore; she has not lowered it. Near the middle of the bridge, between them, a slender elf woman with long pointed ears and silver-white hair, a flute in her hand, stands waiting at the rail, her head tilted, about to ask him a question. Far down in the lake the reflections of the stars have lit again from the north bank toward the city, one by one. Mist and drifting petals are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 三幕：萨碧娜举灯看见北岸那头走来一个人，精灵洛蕾问他那边是什么样子（源稿第290到291行）。洛蕾没有写进 who，只在 text 里写了样子（源稿没写她的发色，银白发是我补的）。

nodes.name: 空位
nodes.light: soft gold of an early evening low from the left, the pale cyan glow of the lakebed ring in the water, cool blue shade
nodes.camera: at bench height from the side, a little behind the boy on the rail, looking past him at the man and the empty place; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early evening in late spring on the long bridge of a lake-city. In the near middle, seen from the side at three-quarter, the flute player sits alone on a stone bench built into the bridge rail: a thin man of forty-four in a dark blue coat, blue-black hair, lake-blue eyes, a still, courteous, unsmiling face, a small bone vial at his belt, and a long flute hanging on the wall of the gatehouse behind him. Beside him on the bench, on his far side from us, is an empty place with a cup set on it and nobody sitting there; he keeps one hand resting on the bench next to it. Two steps away on the stone rail of the bridge sits a small wet-haired boy of about seven in a boatman's smock, swinging his heels, looking at the man; he holds a reed in his lap and does not blow it. Below them in the clear water a great ring of pale cyan light lies on the lakebed, and the man is turned a little toward it, listening. The long bridge runs away to the right into mist, a hanging lamp at this end still unlit, a string of old bells under the gatehouse. Boats rest on the water, and the palace stands in the distance with its windows glowing in tiers. Drifting petals and floating specks of light are large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 收束：他不吹笛，身旁总空着一个位子，被沙救回的孩子夜夜坐在两步远的桥栏上，湖底石环亮了他侧耳听（源稿第303到304行）。

雷米.when: 月银纪5380年炎潮月立盟前一夜
雷米.where: 神渡北岸，桥头外的雾里
雷米.how: 他提着那盏不点的灯在雾里来回带了七趟人，第八趟没有回来。天亮雾散，桥头底下只剩那盏灯。

柯黛.where: 白石台地与坛心岛的盟坛
柯黛.how: 她跑进黑石的阵里递了信，接过回信往回跑，七支箭一支接着一支。她跑到了，把回信递上去，才倒下。收兵者在她身边坐了一夜，天亮的时候她没有醒。

notes: 雷米死的时候十四岁，按规矩不出图，只写了死期；伊妮德、艾德蒙德、萨碧娜活过这一段。
埃德加（5420年死）和嘉兰（约5390年死）源稿只有一句，没有地点和经过，没写死期。
安瑟姆死的那一幅画的是他约七十七岁站盟坛那七天，不是死那一年的样子，岁数栏照死的时候写98。
洛蕾有立绘（zg5_lorel）但不在这一段的人物表里，没进 who，只在 m20_b3 的 text 里写了样子，银白发是我补的。
m20_a4 里没有立绘的信使和老兔耳，都是我按源稿的一句话写成一般的人，没有点名。
柯黛是相遇不是旅伴，按规矩不画死的那一刻，她的最后一跑放在节点 m20_a3 里。

安瑟姆·雾桥.how: 他在盟坛前站了七天，没有一个人敢推他下来，那一回的执冠者就是他。往后他当了四十年执冠者的骑士，约5461年死在星湖。

later_deaths.name: 站满七天
later_deaths.light: low orange sunset from behind the crowd, long shadows, the white of his hair edged with gold
later_deaths.camera: low, from the side of the altar steps, looking up at him from just behind the shield rim; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: the seventh day of a stand before a great stone altar on an island of altars, at dusk. In the middle of the picture, tall and straight, stands the old knight Anselm Mistbridge, here about seventy-seven: still 186 cm, broad now, his reed-coloured hair gone white, his honey-brown brows white and thick, honey-amber eyes calm and steady, a lined face, in dented grey mail and a plain white surcoat. His left leg is stiff and set a little behind the right. In front of him he holds a huge round tower shield, old and mended along a long seam with iron straps, painted with a ring of lake and one star, planted in the stone like a wall; his right hand rests on the pommel of a sword still in its sheath. He has been standing so for seven days: at his feet lie the stubs of three small fires and a folded blanket. Around him in a wide half-circle at a respectful distance stand the armed retainers of six kingdoms in six house colours, their hands at their sides, none of them stepping forward. On the altar behind him an iron crown lies in an open iron box beside a great brass scale. Behind them the low sun burns orange across three rivers. Dust, smoke and a few drifting embers are large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿写他约5461年死在星湖，没有死因。画他一生最后的大事：5420年以后在盟坛前站满七天（第419行），那一年他约七十七岁，岁数写的是死的时候。
